auth.name: Name
auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A long sentence makes a good password.

admin.title: Users
admin.name: Name
admin.confirmDisable: Disable {name}? They cannot sign in from now on; their entries stay.
admin.emptyBody: Add your staff by pasting a list of names and email addresses.
admin.pasteHelp: Paste a list: one person per line, for example copied from Excel or as "Name <address>". Everyone gets an email with a link for setting their password.
admin.outcomeEmailFailed: Added, but the email did not go out – send again

teams.title: Teams
teams.newHelp: You become the team's lead. You can invite members right after.
teams.name: Team name
teams.emptyTitle: You are not in any team yet

teams.confirmRemove: Remove {name} from the team? Their entries stay.
teams.confirmDelete: Delete the team {team} with its projects and tags?
teams.readOnlyProject: This is a project of the team {team}. Only a lead of the team can change it.
teams.readOnlyTag: This is a tag of the team {team}. Only a lead of the team can change it.

teams.nobodyFound: Nobody to invite matches the search.
teams.inviteHelp: The person sees a question in HexTime and joins only after saying yes. New people are added to the organisation by an administrator.

teams.joinHelp: As a member you see the team's projects and can book time on them. The team sees only your total hours on its projects, never your single entries.
